_comment: Per-project config for scripts/readiness.py. See RELEASE_READINESS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md. Append one object per review panel to `panels`; each is {"id": "A", "commits": ["<sha>"], "models": ["opus", "sonnet", "haiku"], "findings": {"HIGH": 1, "MEDIUM": 2}, "note": "..."}. `findings` counts NEW confirmed defects by severity; an empty {} is a clean panel; `models` lists the distinct models that participated.

panels.note: reader.load_grids leaked raw KeyError/ParseError for zip-shaped-but-non-xlsx files (renamed .zip / corrupt [Content_Types].xml) instead of the promised ValueError, escaping the CLI as an uncaught traceback. Opus singleton; reproduced and fixed.

Three singletons (haiku clean). MEDIUM (opus): _is_secondary_header counted a blank candidate cell as type-distinct, swallowing a first data row with an empty optional column as a stacked header. LOW (sonnet): --header-threshold out-of-range exited 1 (runtime) not 2 (usage); added _unit_float validator. LOW (sonnet): trim_decorative docstring promised 'returned unchanged' but keeps the last row -- corrected the docstring (the behaviour is right for detection).

First clean panel at full diversity. No new behavioural defects across all three slots; both Panel 2 fixes independently verified intact. Only two dismissed NIT-level observations: an orchestrate.py docstring orientation typo ('1xN' -> 'Nx1', corrected in 9a8f795, non-behavioural) and a self-consistent data_start_row=max_row+1 quirk on header-only decorative regions (no change). Opus's sub-agent degeneracy-penalty candidate was adjudicated and rejected (its fix would regress legitimate single-record tables).

Second consecutive clean panel at full diversity, steered into surfaces panels 1-3 under-exercised: Unicode/exotic whitespace (ZWS, NBSP), _jsonable/to_dict over the full object graph (error cells, rich text, datetimes), text-vs-JSON renderer agreement, style detection (gradient/indexed fills), sheet-name/ordering edges, coordinate overflow, and end-to-end xlfilldown ingest. No new defects. Three reviewer observations all adjudicated non-defects (ZWS treated as text is consistent with the documented str.strip() contract; an embedded-newline header label is cosmetic; a null-byte filename still exits 1 correctly). No code changes -- HEAD identical to the reviewed commit.
